TextView.android:text: Configure audio feedback for different events. Each sound can be enabled/disabled and has individual volume control.
Subtle tick when radiation data arrives
Sound when a smart alert triggers
Note: Ambient audio will play continuously while enabled. Keep volume low for subtle atmosphere.

Simulates a Geiger counter by synthesizing clicks matching the CPS rate. Adjust parameters to craft your ideal tick sound -- from sharp metallic clicks to soft muffled thumps. Enable on the dashboard with the Geiger toggle.
When enabled, alerts with voice enabled will be spoken aloud using the VEGA AI voice synthesizer. Each alert can individually enable/disable voice in the Alert Settings.

Looking for the perfect sounds? Check freesound.org for free Creative Commons sounds:

• Data tick: Search 'soft click' or 'subtle blip'
• Connected: Search 'connection established sci-fi'
• Disconnected: Search 'disconnect tone'
• Alarm: Search 'sci-fi alert alarm'
• Anomaly: Search 'glitch detection'

Place .wav files in app/src/main/res/raw/
